text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a non-review research paper focused on estimating state-level soil carbon emission factors under various land use change scenarios associated with biofuel feedstock production. While it uses assumed land use change scenarios (e.g., conversion from cropland, grassland, forest to bioenergy crops), it does not perform or focus on predicting or modeling future land use/land cover (LULC) change itself. Instead, LULC conversions are prescribed inputs to assess soil carbon impacts. The study lacks spatially explicit LULC prediction as its primary objective; rather, it uses pre-defined conversion scenarios without modeling where or how much land will actually change use. Furthermore, although it operates at a national (U.S.) scale with state-level resolution, it does not produce mapped LULC projections nor include quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC predictions—because it doesn’t predict LULC. The core focus is on soil carbon dynamics and emission factors using a surrogate CENTURY model, placing it in the category of biomass/bioenergy/carbon studies that incorporate assumed LULC changes but do not analyze or simulate LULC change itself, thus meeting exclusion criterion: “Biomass/bioenergy/carbon studies without LULC change analysis.”)
